Fluent in English and Spanish Why Join Us? Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team. Shape the future of investor relations technology. Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients. Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture. If you're excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we'd love to hear from you. This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Ai Agent Manager (Media)
description: About the Product For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Job Purpose The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes. The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization. Duties and Responsibilities Main Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.G., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks). Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.G., media planning, operations, finance workflows). Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems. Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic. Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users. Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases. Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements. Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability. Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems. Core Requirements 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role. Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic. Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.G., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms). Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms). Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) Technical / AI-Related Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts). Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus. Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required. Soft Skills Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders. Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes. Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches. Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment. Domain Experience Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents. Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs. Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT. Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative. Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles. Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements. We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote. As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Ai Reasoning Engineer (Mathematics & Python)
description: Company Description MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specializes in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimization, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website. Role Description We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions. Offer Details: Pay: $1500 per month (Net/take-home) Mode of work - Fully Remote Responsibilities: Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies Required Qualifications: 5+ years in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science — competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research background Python programming — NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy) Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations. Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers — not subjective or open-ended. Experience with AI coding benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-bench) Comfortable with Docker — writing Dockerfiles, building images, and debugging container issues. Understanding of numerical methods — floating point tolerance, convergence criteria, error bounds. Strong plus: Experience creating math competition problems (AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar). Research in mathematics, theoretical CS, or quantitative fields. Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification. Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI). Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing Example of what you will produce: A task requiring analysis of a system of 50 coupled differential equations modeling a chemical reaction network. The agent must determine equilibrium concentrations, stability conditions, and bifurcation points. Input includes the reaction network as a matrix, rate constants, and initial conditions. The verifier checks numerical answers with tolerance (1e-6), validates eigenvalue analysis for stability, and confirms bifurcation parameter ranges. The decomposition splits into 4 sub-agents: one computes equilibria, one analyzes local stability, one maps bifurcations, and one synthesizes the phase portrait. Oracle scores 1.0, single-agent scores 0.25, multi-agent scores 0.80. Offer Details: Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST. Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave). Duration of Contract: 6months (expected start date is next week). How to Apply? Please send us your updated CV to with job ID 75046 in the email subject line.

title: Sap S/4hana Finance Consultant
description: Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support. The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics. The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion. Duties and Responsibilities: The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction. Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and data reconciliation activities Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes Provide post-go-live support and stabilization understanding of role-based access and user experience Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred). Required Certifications: Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus. Other: Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.G., LATAM delivery centers) Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Especialista Em Infraestrutura Azure
description:

Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview: We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding. In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models. This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines. Key Responsibilities: Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer Required Skills and Qualifications: Core Skills Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills Clear and concise written communication Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness) Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data Behavioral Traits High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset Preferred Backgrounds: Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus Offer Details: Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 4 weeks;
(expected start date isnext week) Evaluation Process: Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps. title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About Nature CoNature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
* OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se àNossa Equipe de Saúde Digital! A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. * SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. * O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;
DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES: Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS Formação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Títulode Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos.. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO I MPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

support questions Launch a simple QA process for AI responses Create a repeatable system for updating customer-facing and internal knowledge when the business changes Make it easier for team members conversations and turning patterns into process improvements Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to turn messy information customer truth. title: Devops Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an NOC / I nfrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems. Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents. Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions. Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks. Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents. Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions. Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation. Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks. Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems. Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines. Requirements 8+ years of IT experience. MUST BE fluent in English. 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment. Experience with Windows or Linux server administration. Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes. Strong documentation and communication skills. Preferred Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD). Cloud platform administration experience;
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred. Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting. Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms. Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and guide a team. Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and project management tools. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make strategic decisions in a fast-paced environment. Strong knowledge of data privacy regulations like CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and their implications for web development. Experience implementing data protection mechanisms, including consent management, data encryption, and access controls. Familiarity with One Trust or similar systems privacy and compliance features, including the ability to configure and enforce data protection settings. Proven ability and experience in building highly skilled product teams and mentoring a team of developers. Strong sense of urgency in delivering results and high cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity. Operate as a change agent at multiple levels of an organization with outstanding organizational, communication, interpersonal, relationship-building skills conducive to collaboration at all levels.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description: No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio. Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas. Requisitos necessários Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua. Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI. Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares. #SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‐onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description: About Regrow Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices. About the Role As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains. This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth. What You’ll Do Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close. Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts. Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions. Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context. Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions. Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals. Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil. What You’ll Bring Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments. Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term. Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions. Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms. Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller. Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals. Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts. Native or near-native Portuguese fluency. Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly. Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil. Nice to Have Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies. Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries. Working knowledge of Spanish. Why Regrow Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale. High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership. A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise. Competitive compensation and benefits. Acerca de Regrow Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas. Sobre el Rol Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos. Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR. Qué Harás Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre. Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas. Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast. Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras. Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local. Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas. Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias. Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil. Qué Aportarás Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos. Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo. Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial. Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras. Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS. Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional. Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas. Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento. Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués. Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular. Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil. Deseable Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento. Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales. Conocimiento funcional del español. Por Qué Regrow Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala. Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real. Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica. Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company Description Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities. Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey. Role Description As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results. With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence. Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality. Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life. Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics. Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities. Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality. Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records. Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes. Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences. Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management. Qualifications Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable. Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes. Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies. Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions. Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders. Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

Combinando o legado de uma marca renomada com o modelo de gestão mais eficiente do mercado, nosso Programa de Estágio oferece a oportunidade de aprender, se desenvolver e crescer junto com uma empresa que tem o propósito de ser a mais amada, a que mais cresce e a mais eficiente. Buscamos alguém curioso, analítico e organizado para atuar na interface entre pessoas & dados. Esse(a) estagiário(a) será responsável por apoiar na construção e no acompanhamento de indicadores de RH e em análises que apoiem decisões do negócio. Além disso, auxiliará também nas rotinas gerais de People, prestando atendimento aos colaboradores e participando ativamente de reuniões e ações da área. Se você gosta de números, organização e quer desenvolver um olhar estratégico dentro de RH, essa oportunidade é para você! Oportunidade: Estágio em People Analytics Nível de ensino: Cursando ensino superior em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Psicologia, Estatística, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas. Atribuições: Apoiar na coleta, organização e atualização de bases de dados de RH. Auxiliar na construção e acompanhamento de indicadores (headcount, turnover, absenteísmo, entre outros). Apoiar na criação e atualização de dashboards e relatórios gerenciais. Realizar análises básicas de dados para geração de insights. Dar suporte na gestão e controle de benefícios (movimentações, conferências e bases) Garantir a qualidade e consistência das informações de People. Apoiar na melhoria de processos e rotinas da área com foco em dados. Interagir com diferentes áreas para levantamento e validação de informações. Auxiliar em rotinas gerais, como desenvolvimento de ações, pesquisa, atendimento e demais iniciativas da área. Requisitos obrigatórios: Estar cursando ensino superior. Disponibilidade para escala 100% presencial (6h diárias, de segunda à sexta-feira). Conhecimento intermediário de Excel (mínimo). Experiência prévia com banco e análise de dados/indicadores. Diferenciais: Inglês e/ou espanhol. Familiaridade com Power BI. Conhecimento de Protheus e Oracle. Experiência prévia em companhias multinacionais.

title: Ai Art Director (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description: So… what the hell is Ark Exotic? Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet. Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film. Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native art direct who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark. What You'll Do Lead a team of designers to create visuals that stop scrolls Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel) Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands Who You Are We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built. You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before You've mastered Freepik Spaces and Higgsfield You understand the difference between\ "looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\ " Your portfolio looks likean A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted. You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster\ "Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand What We're Building The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see. This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed. What We're Offering Competitive salary based on your portfolio 10 days PTO per year Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale Fully remote How to Apply A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Arquiteto De Software
description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. title: Csc Jaguariúna - Especialista De Dados Jr| Legal Intelligence

A prioridade da área é estruturar bases de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e integradas, viabilizando iniciativas como jurimetria, dashboards executivos, automações e soluções de inteligência artificial. Esse cargo nasce para sustentar e acelerar essa agenda, com visão de médio e longo prazo. Papel/Missão do Cargo: O/a Especialista de Dados será responsável por desenhar, construir e evoluir soluções de dados escaláveis para o Jurídico, atuando desde a modelagem e engenharia até a automação e integração entre sistemas. Ambiente com alto nível técnico, autonomia e espaço para propor soluções. Forte conexão com inovação, dados e inteligência artificial. Visibilidade, aprendizado contínuo e oportunidade de crescimento técnico e de impacto. Venha crescer com a gente e fazer parte de um time que aprende junto, entrega impacto real e celebra cada conquista. RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS Responsabilidades e Atribuições: Desenvolver, automatizar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de informações jurídicas. Realizar modelagem de dados analítica, garantindo qualidade, consistência e estrutura adequada para BI, dashboards e análises estratégicas. Implementar e evoluir transformações de dados em Databricks (PySpark), com foco em performance e sustentabilidade. Construir e manter integrações entre sistemas por meio de APIs, scripts e processos ETL/ELT. Apoiar iniciativas de automação de processos, reduzindo atividades manuais e retrabalho no Jurídico. Trabalhar em parceria com áreas jurídicas e de negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas eficazes. Domínio de SQL para consultas, transformação e análise de dados. Experiência prática com Python, aplicada a processamento e automação de dados. Vivência com ambientes de dados escaláveis, como Data Lakes ou plataformas de processamento distribuído. Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma, com visão de solução e foco em entrega. Boa comunicação para interagir com áreas técnicas e não técnicas. Experiências Desejadas Experiência com Databricks e PySpark. Vivência com arquiteturas Lakehouse.
